purpose: Frozen first full learned limiter release experiment; offline paired reference, deterministic native hard fully-wet ceiling unchanged.
model: 32 features -> 32 tanh -> 1 tanh; release_ms=10**(2+output);1089 parameters; MSE on log10 release labels

training.sources: Synthetic native 4-second stepped tone/multisine/noise probes at48k; no external audio; identity variants stay in split

frozen_gates.ambiguity: Reject sampled native objective with another release at >=10% log separation and relative RMS within best+0.001;33 global log probes plus local +/-10%. Finite heuristic, not a continuous global identifiability proof.
frozen_gates.native_sample_ceiling: All full raw-output samples <=10**(threshold_db/20)+2e-6; no true peak certification
frozen_gates.preset_reopen: Native at changed callback257 (or17) must pass waveform gates

comparison: Neural seeds/endpoints versus nine log-grid points plus analytic recovery seed; each <=24 attempted native evaluations; shared33-point ambiguity grid and reopen counted separately. Cache-miss/timing metrics include shared cache and must not be interpreted as isolated speed benchmarks.
scope: Prototype supports native1x hard linked single release, no soft/ISP/dual/oversampling; each fixed profile control explicit. Other native modes remain separate validation work, not presumed supported.
